rationale: Steady-state heat balance per metre at T_max=75C: R_hot=(0.118/1000)*(1+0.00403*(75-20))=1.441547e-4 ohm/m. For each timestamp, convection=0.72*max(wind,0.05)^0.6*(75-ambient); radiation=0.7*5.670374419e-8*(pi*0.0224)*(348.15^4-(ambient+273.15)^4); solar=0.7*solar*(0.0224). Ampacity=sqrt(max(conv+rad-solar,0)/R_hot). Minimum at t01 (451.47 A, hot/calm/sunny), and scheduled 520 A exceeds this rating only at t01.
